name: Orion
source:
Orion was sure he'd never be free, but one day, he was lucky enough to find himself rescued. There was but a single problem. His rescuer happened to be a worse criminal than those he’d known already. When the world abandons us, who are we to turn away from those who show kindness? Even if those people are bandits.

This game is based on the book [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220220144220/https://www.blackdoor.online/books/p/orion-episode-1]Orion Ep 1[/url].
